title: CVC5 Cross-Validation Selection Documentation
selection_criteria: ALL nn.Module models that (1) pass TensorGuard verification as SAFE, (2) produce a valid SMT-LIB 2.6 certificate without UserPropagator extensions, and (3) pass SMT-LIB syntax checks are included. No manual selection or cherry-picking.

failure_modes.description: Uses Z3 UserPropagator extensions not in SMT-LIB 2.6
Model correctly identified as UNSAFE (no cert to validate)

z3_subprocess_results.note: All certificates validated by Z3 subprocess

coverage_analysis.interpretation: 110 out of 193 models produce SMT-LIB certificates suitable for cross-solver validation. The remaining 83 models are excluded for documented, structural reasons (buggy models produce no certificate, non-nn.Module models use a different verification path, etc.).
